events.title: To the Moon - Last Hour RPG is now available!
events.summary: Hey folks, the To the Moon Last Hour RPG demo is now finally available for download d-(' ' d-)It is original content made specifically for the demo, so you wouldn't be cutting into the actual main game when it releases. A fairly short experience (~15 minutes?), but quite packed, and should have enough things to get a good idea of what's to come and then some. events.title: To the Moon Last Hour Update - Progressing Along!
events.summary: Hey folks, just a quick update to let you know that the project is still going well. d-(' ' d-)Lots of work to set up a foundation in the new engine to build future games with, which has been taking a while, but otherwise progressing along nicely! Hoping to wrap up the series nicely with this. Thanks for your patience and being a part of this decade-long journey~
